verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere documents on-device LLM generation and chat, vision-language models, image generation, STT, TTS, VAD and diarization, so it covers LLMs and multi-modal models. Community discussion confirms it runs specific LLMs such as Llama-3.2-3B. Nothing shows breadth on the scale of hundreds of architectures, and MoE and embedding models are never mentioned. Missing for 10: evidence of support for hundreds of model architectures, MoE model support, embedding model support, a documented list of supported architectures.
